title: Teamwork at School, Action Verbs & Hard 'g'

scenes.t: {name} reads two stories. Omar, Youssef, and Ziad went to the park. They saw a big puddle. It was too big to jump over.
Omar found a piece of wood. Youssef and Ziad helped him make a good bridge. They crossed over the bridge and played.
Salma and Youssef had a project at school. At first, they couldn't agree on what to do.
Then, they started to share ideas. Salma wrote, and Youssef drew.
When Salma felt tired, Youssef helped her. They showed care and worked well together.
Finally, they finished the project. Their teacher was happy and said, 'Good job!'
Hard 'g' /g/ comes before a, o, u or at the end: game, go, gum, dog, big, good, green.

items.a: Salma helps Youssef with the project.
They agree on what to do.
A small pool of water on the ground.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the action verb with the sentence.
pairs: We ___ the trip before the holiday.
Mariam ___ a book in the library.

activities.title: Hard 'g' or not?
activities.prompt: Does the word have a hard g /g/?

why.g: g before a, o, u or at the end.
why.x: g before e, i, y is usually soft.

items.q: Salma and Youssef had a ___ at school.
The students (answer / help) the questions together.
Omar (helps / fixes) his friend with homework.
They (fix / plan) the broken chair in class.
Mariam (finds / agrees) a book in the library.

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 86–90
